summary: Li Auto Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 16, 2026, reporting the grant of options under its 2020 Plan and restricted share units under its 2019 Plan to employees or directors. This is a routine equity compensation disclosure by a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a standard 8-K item for compensatory arrangements. There are no merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special-situation elements. No deal terms, premiums, or strategic changes are stated. The filing has no impact on corporate control or capital structure. It is a routine current report, not a special situation.
